newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ building consents up 9.3 pct in Feb yr.
newsitem.headline: NZ building consents up 9.3 pct in Feb yr.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) said on Friday the total value of building consents in the year to February was NZ$6.03 billion.
For non-residential buildings the value of consents rose by 9.3 percent on the same 12-month period to February 1996 to a value of nearly $2.40 billion.
SNZ said the value of consents for residential buildings for the year to February was NZ$3.63 billion, up 9.4 percent.
Consents for 22,805 new dwelling units were issued in the year ended February, 7.9 percent more than the 21,129 recorded for the year ended February 1996.
The national median consent value for new dwelling units authorised in February was $110,000.
